host: Apple M3 Max, 96 GiB unified memory, macOS 27.0.1
harness: Each test ran in its own process (`--ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads 1`), so peak memory is per test.
notes: Experimental validation only: no checkpoint below is advertised as supported by this record (AGENTS.md requires further memory, context, quantization and performance gates).
Llama-family, Gemma and gpt-oss weights are cast to F32 while streaming; Metal runs in F32 except Qwen3.5 (F16) and DeepSeek-V2-Lite (F16 smoke).

Qwen2-7B is compared with an F64 Transformers reference; its Metal first-position logit deviates 1.9e-3 where F32 Transformers itself deviates 1.6e-3 (see tests/llama_family_artifacts.rs), so it runs with TRANSFORMERS_LLAMA_FAMILY_TOLERANCE=2.5e-3.
gpt-oss-20b references are truncated (1 and 4 decoder blocks) F32 Transformers evaluations of the real weights; the full 24-block model is not compared here.
Timings in the log come from a host shared with other builds and are not performance measurements.
